concepts.title: 指数函数与指数规则
concepts.summary: $f(x)=ca^x$，$a>0,a\ne1,c\ne0$。变量在指数中；正底数保证对每个实数都定义。

method.title: 识别底数
method.body: 区分 $a^x$ 与 $x^a$，检查底数为正常数。

pitfalls: 负底数的有理幂只在部分输入可取实数；底数为0还会使负指数无定义。

en.title: Exponential functions and exponent rules
en.summary: $f(x)=ca^x$, where $a>0$, $a\ne1$, and $c\ne0$. The variable occurs in the exponent, and a positive base permits every real input.

method.title: Identify the base
method.body: Distinguish $a^x$ from $x^a$ and check that the base is a positive constant.

pitfalls: Negative bases allow only some real inputs; base zero also makes negative exponents undefined.

en.title: Exponential graphs and transformations
en.summary: $a^x$ passes through $(0,1)$ and has horizontal asymptote $y=0$. It increases when $a>1$ and decreases when $0<a<1$.

method.title: Track points
method.body: Use $(-1,1/a),(0,1),(1,a)$ and track shifts, stretches, and reflections.

e0$. The domain is all real numbers; the range is $(k,\infty)$ for $c>0$ or $(-\infty,k)$ for $c<0$, and the asymptote is $y=k$. If $m=0$, the function is constant, $g(x)=ca^d+k$, with that single value as its range.

pitfalls: $a^{-x}$ reflects across the $y$-axis; $-a^x$ reflects across the $x$-axis. Horizontal shifts do not change the horizontal asymptote.

concepts.title: 由点确定指数函数
concepts.summary: 用两点建立 $y_1=ca^{x_1}$ 与 $y_2=ca^{x_2}$；相除消去 $c$。

method.title: 求底数
method.body: 要求两点横坐标不同且纵坐标非零、同号：$a^{x_2-x_1}=y_2/y_1$，取正底数。若比值为1，只得到常数底数 $a=1$，不属于本节的非常数指数函数。

method.title: 回代
method.body: $c=y_1/a^{x_1}$；把两点分别代回检验。

en.title: Determine an exponential function from points
en.summary: From two points, write $y_1=ca^{x_1}$ and $y_2=ca^{x_2}$, then divide to eliminate $c$.

method.title: Find the base
method.body: Require distinct x-coordinates and nonzero y-coordinates of the same sign. Then $a^{x_2-x_1}=y_2/y_1$; choose the positive base. If the ratio is 1, the resulting base is $a=1$, which is constant rather than a nonconstant exponential function.

method.title: Substitute back
method.body: $c=y_1/a^{x_1}$. Check both points in the final formula.

concepts.title: 单利与线性变化
concepts.summary: 单利 $I=Prt$，本利和 $A=P(1+rt)$。相等时间增加固定数额是线性变化。

method.title: 统一单位
method.body: $r$ 用小数；$t$ 用年，月数除以12。

method.title: 算利息与余额
method.body: 先算 $I=Prt$，再算 $A=P+I$。

en.title: Simple interest and linear change
en.summary: Simple interest is $I=Prt$, and the future value is $A=P(1+rt)$. A fixed amount added in equal time intervals gives linear change.

method.title: Use consistent units
method.body: Express $r$ as a decimal and $t$ in years; divide months by 12.

method.title: Compute interest and balance
method.body: Find $I=Prt$, then $A=P+I$.

concepts.title: 复利、现值和有效年利率

method.title: 建立模型
method.body: 确定 $P,r,n,t$，每期利率是 $r/n$，期数是 $nt$。

pitfalls: 按日复利本节取每年365次；中间不提前四舍五入。

en.title: Compound interest, present value, and annual yield
en.summary: With $n$ compounding periods per year, $A=P(1+r/n)^{nt}$ and $P=A(1+r/n)^{-nt}$.

method.title: Set up the model
method.body: Identify $P,r,n,t$. The periodic rate is $r/n$ and the number of periods is $nt$.

method.title: Solve for unknown quantities
method.body: $r=n[(A/P)^{1/(nt)}-1]$ and the annual yield is $y=(1+r/n)^n-1$. Interest earned is $A-P$.

pitfalls: Daily compounding uses 365 periods per year in this section. Keep full precision until the final rounding.

concepts.title: 数 e 与连续复利
concepts.summary: $e=\lim_{n\to\infty}(1+1/n)^n\approx2.718281828$；自然指数函数为 $e^x$，连续复利为 $A=Pe^{rt}$。

method.title: 代入连续模型
method.body: 连续计息时使用 $e^{rt}$；反求现值用 $P=Ae^{-rt}$。

method.title: 图像与指数法则
method.body: $e^x$ 的图像性质与底数大于1的指数函数相同；$e^{u+v}=e^ue^v$。

en.title: The number e and continuous compounding
en.summary: $e=\lim_{n\to\infty}(1+1/n)^n\approx2.718281828$. The natural exponential function is $e^x$, and continuous compounding gives $A=Pe^{rt}$.

method.title: Use the continuous model
method.body: For continuous compounding, use $e^{rt}$. Present value is $P=Ae^{-rt}$.

method.title: Graphs and exponent rules
method.body: $e^x$ has the same graph properties as any exponential with base greater than 1, and $e^{u+v}=e^ue^v$.

concepts.title: 指数增长与衰减模型
concepts.summary: 连续模型 $A(t)=A_0e^{kt}$ 在 $A_0>0$ 时，$k>0$增长、$k<0$衰减；若 $A_0<0$，递增递减方向反转；$A_0=0$ 或 $k=0$ 为常函数。离散百分比变化用 $A_0(1+r)^t$，实数时间要求 $1+r>0$。

method.title: 确定时间原点
method.body: $A_0=A(0)$；年份减去基准年得到 $t$，基准年前 $t<0$。

method.title: 保持模型约定
method.body: 连续相对增长率 $k$ 与每期百分比 $r$ 不相同：$e^k=1+r$。若有环境温度常数，指数项趋于0后保留该常数。

pitfalls: 题目给出公式时按给定公式计算；不得把 $e^{-.15t}$ 与 $(.85)^t$ 当成同一模型。

en.title: Exponential growth and decay models
en.summary: For $A(t)=A_0e^{kt}$ with $A_0>0$, $k>0$ gives growth and $k<0$ gives decay. If $A_0<0$, increase/decrease reverses; $A_0=0$ or $k=0$ gives a constant. A discrete percentage change uses $A_0(1+r)^t$, with $1+r>0$ for arbitrary real time.

method.title: Set the time origin
method.body: $A_0=A(0)$. Subtract the reference year to get $t$, which is negative before that year.

method.title: Keep the model convention
method.body: The continuous relative rate $k$ and discrete percentage rate $r$ differ: $e^k=1+r$. If an ambient-temperature constant is present, it remains after the exponential term tends to zero.

pitfalls: Use a formula explicitly given in a problem. Do not identify $e^{-.15t}$ with $(.85)^t$.

concepts.title: 习题拓展：证明与渐近行为
concepts.summary: 此知识点来自节后习题：指数恒等式、阶乘近似、负底数有理幂以及多种渐近行为。

method.title: 先化简再判断
method.body: 使用指数规则精确化简；所有除法注明分母非零。

method.title: 比较极限
method.body: 分别考察 $x\to\infty$ 与 $x\to-\infty$；负底数有理幂先把分数约为最简再检查分母奇偶。

en.title: Exercise extensions: identities and end behavior
en.summary: This topic comes from the exercises: exponential identities, factorial approximations, rational powers of negative bases, and end behavior.

method.title: Simplify before concluding
method.body: Use exponent rules exactly and note nonzero denominators.

method.title: Compare limiting behavior
method.body: Check $x\to\infty$ and $x\to-\infty$ separately. For rational powers of negative bases, reduce the fraction and check the denominator parity.

en.prompt: Graph the exponential functions and state the domain, range, and horizontal asymptote: (a)$f(x)=3^x$; (b)$f(x)=(1/2)^x$.

steps.body: (a) Start with the basic exponential graph of base $3$; keep the basic graph, obtaining $f(x)=3^x$.

steps.body: (a) Set the exponent equal to $-1,0,1$ to get the points $(-1,\frac{1}{3}), (0,1), (1,3)$ (nonrational coordinates are approximate). Join them with a smooth curve that approaches but never crosses the asymptote.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: (b) The exponential factor is always positive, so the domain is $(-\infty,\infty)$, the range is $(0,\infty)$, and the horizontal asymptote is $y=0$.

en.answer: (a) Domain $(-\infty,\infty)$; range $(0,\infty)$; asymptote $y=0$. (b) Domain $(-\infty,\infty)$; range $(0,\infty)$; asymptote $y=0$.

en.prompt: Consider $g(x)=(-3)^x$, which is not an exponential function. What rational numbers $x$ make $g(x)$ defined as a real number?

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: For $(-3)^{p/q}$, take the $q$th root of $(-3)^p$. An odd $q$ always permits a real root, and negative $p$ is allowed because the base is nonzero.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: If $q$ is even, lowest terms forces $p$ to be odd; then $(-3)^p<0$ has no real even root. Thus an odd reduced denominator is necessary and sufficient.

exercises.prompt: 求方程 $2^x=2x$ 的所有解。如何知道已找到全部解？

steps.title: 步骤 2
steps.body: $x\le0$ 时右边 $2x\le0$，左边 $2^x>0$，所以无解。

steps.title: 步骤 3
steps.body: 为排除其他正解，令 $H(x)=2^x-2x$。指数曲线严格凸（向上弯曲）：若 $u\ne v$，由严格算术—几何平均不等式，$2^{(u+v)/2}=\sqrt{2^u2^v}<(2^u+2^v)/2$；连续性把该中点性质推广为严格凸性。减去直线 $2x$ 保持严格凸。

steps.title: 步骤 4
steps.body: 严格凸函数不可能有三个不同零点：若 $r_1<r_2<r_3$ 都为零，严格凸性使中间点的值严格小于连接两端零点的线段值0，矛盾。因此已找到的两个解是全部解。

en.prompt: Find all solutions of $2^x=2x$. How do you know you have found all solutions?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Direct substitution gives $x=1$ ($2=2$) and $x=2$ ($4=4$).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: For $x\le0$, the right side satisfies $2x\le0$ while $2^x>0$, so there is no solution.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: To rule out other positive solutions, set $H(x)=2^x-2x$. The exponential curve is strictly convex: for $u\ne v$, strict arithmetic–geometric mean gives $2^{(u+v)/2}=\sqrt{2^u2^v}<(2^u+2^v)/2$. Continuity extends this midpoint property to strict convexity. Subtracting the line $2x$ preserves strict convexity.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: A strictly convex function cannot have three distinct zeros: if $r_1<r_2<r_3$ were zeros, the middle value would be strictly below the line segment joining the outer zeros, hence below zero, a contradiction. Thus the two verified solutions are all solutions.
